name: Nefazodone
effects: SARI mechanism similar to trazodone — 5-HT2A antagonism + SERT inhibition
Brand name Serzone withdrawn due to hepatotoxicity; generic available
BLACK BOX WARNING: life-threatening hepatic failure (risk ~1 in 250,000 patient-years)
Minimal sexual dysfunction and sedation vs SSRIs
Potent CYP3A4 inhibitor — significant drug interaction potential (simvastatin, triazolam, etc.)
Risk of serotonin syndrome with other serotonergic agents
